stemMd: A gallery admits groups of exactly 4 or exactly 7 people. Which total cannot be formed by two admitted groups?

options.label: A
options.textMd: All the other listed totals are possible.

explanationMd: The possible two-group totals are 4+4=8, 4+7=11 and 7+7=14. Twelve is absent. This enumerates all unordered choices of two allowed group sizes.

distractorRationale.d: Two groups of four total eight.
distractorRationale.b: Two groups of seven total fourteen.
distractorRationale.a: Twelve is not among the three possible sums.
